approval_note: SYNTHETIC DEMO SCRIPT. Not reviewed or approved by Henry Ford Health, an IRB, or clinical leadership. Fixture and internal test numbers only.
program_name: Henry Ford Health kidney care education team (demo)
opening: Hello, this is an automated assistant calling on behalf of the Henry Ford Health kidney care education team. This is a demo call and it is not recorded. Is now an okay time to talk for about two minutes?

closing.scheduling_requested: Thank you. A coordinator will call you during the time you chose to explain the program and answer your questions. Nothing has been signed up yet. Goodbye.
closing.declined: No problem at all. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
closing.callback_later: No problem. We may try again another time. Goodbye.
closing.wrong_number: Sorry for the trouble. We will update our records. Goodbye.
closing.opted_out: Understood. We will not call you again about this program. Goodbye.
closing.not_eligible: Thanks for letting me know. This program is for adults who are receiving or preparing for dialysis, so it may not be a fit. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
closing.needs_human: Thank you. That is a great question for a member of our care team, so I will ask a coordinator to follow up with you. I cannot give medical advice on this call. Goodbye.
closing.language_unsupported: Thank you. I will ask a coordinator who can help in your language to follow up. Goodbye.

identity_or_availability_check.prompt: Is now an okay time to talk for about two minutes?

q_dialysis.prompt: Are you currently receiving dialysis, or has your care team talked with you about starting dialysis?

q_adult.prompt: Are you 18 years of age or older?

q_interest.prompt: Henry Ford Health offers free education sessions with a nurse educator about dialysis options, including home dialysis. Would you be interested in learning more?

q_handoff.prompt: A coordinator would explain the program and ask for your permission before anything starts. Is it okay for a coordinator to call you back at this number?

q_window.prompt: What time of day usually works best for a call: morning, afternoon, or evening?

faq.answer: I am an automated assistant calling on behalf of the Henry Ford Health kidney care education team.
This call is not recorded and no transcript is kept.
